preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner to modify fee parameters via setBuyFeePercentages/setSellFeePercentages
Fee parameters (liquidityFeeonBuy, liquidityFeeonSell, burnFeeOnBuy, burnFeeOnSell) must be set to 0

violation_target.exploit_hint: 1. Owner calls setBuyFeePercentages(0, 0, 0, 0) and setSellFeePercentages(0, 0, 0, 0) to set all fee parameters to zero. 2. Trigger a token transfer that involves fee collection (transfer to/from uniswapV2Pair). 3. The _takeLiquidity() function will attempt division by zero in the calculation: tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell), causing transaction revert and DOSing contract functionality. 4. Additionally, _getRate() may divide by zero if tSupply becomes 0 through token burns.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The KARMA token contract has a zero division vulnerability in the `_takeLiquidity()` function. The calculation `tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell)` will revert when all fee parameters are set to 0, as the denominator becomes 0. The owner can set these fees via `setBuyFeePercentages()` and `setSellFeePercentages()`. This creates a DoS condition where any transfer involving fee collection will revert.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.startPrank(). 2. Call setBuyFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) and setSellFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) to zero out all fee parameters. 3. Trigger a token transfer to/from the uniswapV2Pair which will call _takeLiquidity() and cause division by zero revert. 4. Verify the oracle condition (sum of fees == 0) is met.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get owner address from contract. 2. Start prank as owner. 3. Set all buy fee percentages to 0. 4. Set all sell fee percentages to 0. 5. Stop prank. 6. Verify fee parameters are 0 (oracle check). 7. Inject tokens to attacker using deal(). 8. Attempt transfer to uniswapV2Pair - expect revert due to division by zero. 9. Confirm contract is DOSed.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The zero division vulnerability exists in `_takeLiquidity()` but to trigger it: 1) Trading must be enabled, 2) Transfer must be between non-excluded addresses (uniswapV2Pair is excluded), 3) Need to get tokens from owner via transfer since deal() doesn't work with reflection tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner to enable trading and set all fees to 0. 2. Transfer tokens from owner to attacker (owner is excluded so no fees). 3. Create a victim address and have attacker transfer to victim (neither excluded, triggers fee calculation). 4. This will hit _takeLiquidity() with denominator = 0, causing revert.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Start prank as owner. 2. Enable trading. 3. Set all fee percentages to 0. 4. Stop prank. 5. Verify oracle condition (fees sum to 0). 6. Transfer tokens from owner to attacker. 7. Create victim address. 8. Attempt transfer from attacker to victim - expect revert from division by zero.
attempts.failure_reflection: The test timed out because: 1) The `deal()` cheatcode doesn't work properly with reflection tokens that use `_rOwned`/`_tOwned` mappings. 2) The uniswapV2Pair is excluded from fees in the constructor, so transfers to it won't trigger the vulnerable code path. 3) Trading needs to be enabled first before transfers between non-excluded addresses work.
